issue.body:
If an `auto_date_histogram` has an `ip_range` under it we frequently have to merge "empty" `ip_range` aggregations with "non-empty" `ip_range` aggregations. This was failing because those "empty" `ip_range` aggregations had a different number of ranges than the "non-empty" ranges. This fixes that. No "empty" `ip_range` aggregations have the same size as their "non-empty" counterparts.

Closes #90121
